summary: Rename Rust crates and client packages to Fractal source identities; preserve historical upgrade classifications

replay.detail: The rename changes source identities only. Stored claims and projections do not change.

schema.detail: Schema versions, serialized constants and hash domains stay unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, claim kinds and signed history stay unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust consumers use fractal-* packages and canonical imports. JavaScript consumers use @fractal/client, @fractal/scenarios, @fractal/views, @fractal/ui and @fractal/sdk. The public generated client is FractalClient. Source aliases are removed. Binary target names, wire names, environment variables, state paths and existing Nix output attributes stay unchanged.

downtime.detail: The source-only rename requires no state migration or service switch.

manual.detail: Operators need no action. Source consumers update their package selectors and imports.

recovery.detail: Older releases read the same state. The executor cache identity and installed provider paths stay stable. Historical source-version readers still accept previous source paths.
